        answer = (answer * nCr(n, pop, fac, mod)) % mod;
        if (k != 0) {
            answer = (answer * 2) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(answer);

        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;

        long numerator = fac[n];
        long denominator = (long) fac[r] * fac[n - r] % mod;
        return numerator * powMod(denominator, mod - 2, mod) % mod;
